scientific_integrity: Analytic bijection and characteristic-polynomial proof for every n>=3; exact-integer stand-alone verification and finite exhaustive checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts exactly two classes on each labelled simple cycle prism for n>=3; no claim of maximum partition size, graph automorphism orbits, or other products. Earlier cubic-graph literature was partially inaccessible; historical priority remains a risk.
title: Exact two-total-domatic colouring counts of cycle prisms
